messages:
maria: Quick APAC quota handoff — vendor (CloudWave) says they can free up +8 A100s for a 2-week reservation but need a PO/invoice cleared. Terraform PR is blocked on quota. Who can confirm billing contact and merge owner? Any objections to temporary reservation?

sam: I can take PR review today, send the PR link.

maria: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4528 — it bumps module.gpu_pool to size=12 and wires provider alias `apac`.

ajay: +1 for the two-week temp reservation. Finance will need a PO number and vendor T&Cs review. Priya, can you confirm billing contact?

priya: looping in finance. intake email is finance-sr@redwood.com; I can prep the PO if legal signs off on standard terms. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: CloudWave: invoice CH-2398 generated (draft), due net-15. Link: https://portal.cloudwave.example/invoices/CH-2398 Attach: SOW_CloudWave_APAC.pdf

lee: No technical objections, but please add an autoscaler safeguard so we don't immediately burst capacity. Suggest `autoscaler.min_replicas = 2`.

sam: Reviewing the infra PR now. Quick note: `module.gpu_pool` tfvar `instance_type` needs confirmation for A100 SKU. Leaving inline comments.

maria: If we get the PO today vendor will reserve slots tomorrow morning APAC time. Can someone confirm a capacity test window Wed 00:00-04:00 UTC?

ajay: Wed 00:00-04:00 UTC works for me, I'll be on call for the canary run.

priya: Finance can issue PO by EOD if legal clears. Pinged legal for the standard SLA review.

sam: PR comments posted, nothing blocking. Once PO is in I can merge and run the targeted apply.

maria: Copy. Leaving the apply runbook snippet here for whoever merges:
```
# from infra/terraform workspace
git fetch origin && git checkout pr/4528
terraform init -backend-config=apac.tfbackend
terraform plan -var='apac_pool_size=12'
terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool -auto-approve
```

lee: Add `--var='maintenance_window=wed-00-04-utc'` so autoscaler doesn't evict during the test.

sam: I'll include that var in the apply command.

vendor-bot: CloudWave: reservation confirmed for 8xA100 (rack A3). ETA: 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. Invoice CH-2398 status: pending PO.

maria: Perfect — tagging folks: @sam @ajay @priya @lee. I'll post updates if schedule slides or PO changes. :rocket:
